description: The file defines the MBVardefs class, which manages variable definitions for modules within the SuiteCRM/MVC framework. It provides methods to load, merge, update, and save vardef configurations, as well as process templates for module field definitions.

classes.name: MBVardefs
classes.description: A class responsible for managing module variable definitions, including loading templates, merging definitions, and persisting changes.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the MBVardefs object with module name, path, and key name, and loads existing vardefs.

methods.name: loadTemplate
methods.description: Loads a template vardef file and integrates its fields and relationships into the current vardefs.

methods.name: mergeVardefs
methods.description: Merges multiple templates' vardefs into a single vardef structure for the module.

methods.name: updateVardefs
methods.description: Updates the current vardefs by merging templates.

methods.name: getVardefs
methods.description: Returns the current full vardefs array.

methods.name: getVardef
methods.description: Returns the current individual vardef array.

methods.name: addFieldVardef
methods.description: Adds a new field vardef to the current definition.

methods.name: deleteField
methods.description: Removes a specific field vardef from the current vardefs.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Persists the current vardefs to the file system with a header.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Generates the vardefs PHP file at a specified path.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Loads vardefs from the filesystem if the vardefs.php file exists.
